== Summary ==
Slip “The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (598, 75, 1110, 798)). Version [[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]] (Original). Not a recreation.
